text:
Jordan: Quick flag: onboarding team saw duplicated welcome emails in staging after a short 429 blip. Two identical delivery events within ~400ms.
Mei: Oof. Was that from the sampleapp prewarm?
Jordan: Yep. Sampleapp fires a POST /send_welcome on startup to validate plumbing. Our client retries on 429 with full-jitter base=50ms, so sometimes two deliveries slip through.
Arman: Which SDKs are affected? We had parity gaps before.
Jordan: Go client retries aggressively and doesn't auto-add Idempotency-Key; Node/Python do and mostly avoid dupes.
Mei: Short-term mitigation: make sampleapp prewarm use GET /health and avoid sending actual welcome emails. But long-term we need a safer client default.
Arman: Proposal: add an advisory header X-Redwood-Safe-Replay: advisory-token. Server will dedupe advisory tokens for a 3s window. Real Idempotency-Key (if provided) still wins. Advisory tokens are cheap to compute and non-guaranteed.
Mei: I like advisory token. Also standardize retry algorithm across SDKs to decorrelated jitter. Proposed defaults: base_ms=180, max_ms=1500, multiplier=2, cap jitter at 1500ms. Make it configurable.
Jordan: Can we make advisory token include instance-id + path + truncated payload fingerprint? Example: base64url(HMAC(instance||path||sha256(payload)))[0:20]. Non-reversible and short.
Arman: Yep. Server keeps an LRU of token->response-pointer for 3s and emits metric replay.advisory.hit/miss.
qa-bot: [test-suggestion] Add CI test: have harness return 429 first, 200 second, and assert sink sees single side-effect when advisory token is present. Run across Node/Go/Python.
Mei: Docs: show two examples. Quick Node snippet for docs:
```
// compute advisory token (pseudo)
const token = makeAdvisoryToken(instanceId, '/v1/send_welcome', JSON.stringify(body));
fetch('/v1/send_welcome', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Retry-Token': token, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) })
```
Jordan: Action items:
- Jordan: patch sampleapp to use GET /health for prewarm and add SAMPLEAPP_SEND_ADVISORY=true opt-in (small hotfix).
- Arman: backend prototype for advisory-token LRU (3s) + metrics.
- Mei: SDKs: parity PRs to auto-add advisory token for mutating calls unless disabled and switch retry to decorrelated jitter (default settings + retry_config option).
- QA-bot: add CI test for advisory token dedupe across SDKs.
infra-bot: [alert] 2026-06-10T10:00:00Z staging canary metrics: onboarding welcome-sends 429 spike detected (p95-retry=320ms)
Mei: Small UX note: clarify in docs when to use persistent Idempotency-Key (payments / guaranteed dedupe) vs advisory token (onboarding / prewarm / short-window dedupe).
Jordan: I'll roll the sampleapp patch to a small canary and post PR link. If duplicates reappear we pause rollout. Thanks. :thumbsup:
